reviews.title: Unfortunately inacurate
reviews.text: In the Persian translations you include words in parenthesis that are tafseer  and not in the actual Arabic words of Quran Kareem. Please be a trustworthy keeper of the words of Allah and move them to tafseer or give an option to hide those interpretations as if words of Allah need clarification! Otherwise perfect may Allah bless you.

app.name: قرآن هادی با ترجمه تفسیر فارسی
